RCSP-191.description: Verify Item Master (Inventory Setup → Inventory Item) page load, controls, filters, search behavior, hierarchy scoping, and exclusion of inactive items from operational transaction forms for WB Unit 1034.

prerequisites: User has valid Back Office credentials and Inventory Setup access
WB Unit 1034 is selected from My Hierarchy

testCases.testName: Verify whether the Item Master page is displayed successfully for WB Unit 1034
Verify whether the Item Master page displays all required search, filter and grid controls
Verify whether Type and Status filters display only records matching the selected filter criteria
Verify whether the Search box returns matching inventory items using item name, PLU and Item Number
Verify whether invalid search input and special characters are handled correctly without breaking the application
Verify whether exact search results are displayed before partial matches in alphabetical order
Verify whether only inventory items assigned to WB Unit 1034 are displayed for the selected hierarchy unit
Verify whether inactive inventory items are excluded from operational transaction forms
Verify whether multiple filters work together correctly on the Item Master page
